'
Til Your River Runs Dry
is a 2013 album by
Eric Burdon
. It is his "first high-profile record in eons and his first album of largely original material since 2004", states
Stephen Thomas Erlewine
in his Allmusic review.
[
1
]
The album peaked number 168 on the
Billboard 200
, #15 on the Billboard Tastemakers and #57 on the German album chart.

6
]
